archive.title: Data archived at expiry
archive.notArchived: Sessions, counters and caches are not archived
archive.onceNote: The archive e-mail is sent only once, so export a copy now.

clear.title: Clear workspace data
clear.body: Delete all business data of the current scenario and return the workspace to its blank state, so you can load another example scenario or import new data.
clear.targetActAs: The target workspace {tid} ({email}) will be cleared, not your own admin workspace.
clear.point2: The ontology (reset to the blank template, including your changes), KPIs, automations and alerts
clear.point3: Saved mappings, scenarios and recommendations that were not executed; running imports are stopped
clear.keptBody: Your account and sessions, today's usage (nothing is refunded), import history, the action audit and executed recommendations.

danger.title: End the trial early and delete
danger.body: Stops the trial now. Your data is packed as a ZIP and the download link is e-mailed to you (valid 7 days); then the account and e-mail are deleted. Requires an e-mail code.
danger.point1: Your workspace data is packed as a ZIP and the link is e-mailed once (valid 7 days)
danger.point2: The account, e-mail and sessions are deleted; you cannot sign in again
danger.point3: We e-mail you a code to confirm this action
danger.codeSent: A code was sent to your e-mail; enter it within 10 minutes.
